name: Carts on a track
summary: Two carts on a 10 m track with mass labels and momentum/velocity arrows; animates 1D elastic or sticky collisions.

name: Spring and mass
summary: Block on a horizontal spring with ruler and restoring-force arrow; displace it and play the oscillation.

name: Electric circuit
summary: Battery with 1–4 resistors or bulbs in series or parallel; animated charge flow, bulb brightness follows power, current/voltage labels.

name: Gas in a cylinder
summary: Cylinder with piston (volume), moving particles (amount, speed from temperature), thermometer and pressure gauge.

name: Projectile launcher
summary: Ball launched over level ground at a set speed, angle and height; animated flight with trail, distance marks and landing mark.

name: Pendulum
summary: Bob on a string with length and release-angle labels; swings with the correct period for its length and gravity.

name: Block on an inclined plane
summary: Block on a ramp of adjustable angle with weight, normal and friction arrows; slides with the real acceleration or stays if friction holds it.

name: Refraction of light
summary: Light ray crossing between two materials with adjustable refractive indices and angle; shows the refracted ray or total internal reflection.

name: Planet orbit
summary: Planet on an adjustable ellipse around a star of adjustable mass; moves faster near the star; distance and speed shown next to the planet.

name: Beaker of solution
summary: Beaker with volume marks whose colour and particle density follow the concentration, or the universal-indicator colour of a pH.

name: Reacting particles
summary: Box of moving A and B particles that react to AB when they collide hard enough; more particles or higher temperature react faster; live counts.

name: Atom model
summary: Shell model for elements 1–20: nucleus with proton and neutron counts, electrons on shells, element name, mass number and charge.

name: Water plant under a lamp
summary: Pondweed in a tank under a lamp; the stream of oxygen bubbles follows the photosynthesis rate set by light, CO₂ and temperature.

name: Number line
summary: Number line with up to three labelled markers and a bracket showing the distance between two of them.

name: Thin lens
summary: Converging or diverging lens on an optical axis with an object arrow, its image and two principal rays; the image moves and flips as the object or focal length changes.

name: Wave on a string
summary: Travelling wave over a metre ruler with its wavelength and amplitude marked; moves at speed = frequency × wavelength.

name: Lever (seesaw)
summary: Beam on a pivot with one load on each side at adjustable distances; tips toward the larger turning effect and sits level when balanced.

name: Floating and sinking
summary: Block in a tank of liquid that floats partly submerged or sinks, depending on the two densities; weight and buoyant-force arrows.

name: Two electric charges
summary: Two point charges a set distance apart with the force arrows on each (attracting or repelling) and the size of the force.

name: Photoelectric effect
summary: Lamp shining light of adjustable wavelength and brightness on a metal plate in a vacuum tube; electrons leave only below the threshold wavelength, faster for shorter wavelengths.

name: Punnett square
summary: 2 × 2 Punnett square for one gene: the parents' alleles along the top and side, the four possible offspring with genotype and flower colour.

name: Phases of the Moon
summary: Moon on its orbit around the Earth with sunlight from one side, next to the Moon's appearance from Earth and the phase name.

name: Fraction bars
summary: One to three bars of equal length cut into equal parts with some shaded, each with its fraction written beside it.

name: Right triangle
summary: Right-angled triangle with adjustable legs; labels for both legs, the hypotenuse and the angle, each of which can be hidden.

name: Line graph
summary: Axes with ticks, labels and up to a few line series; points can be set or added live.

name: Vector arrow
summary: Labelled arrow from a point with a length and direction; use several for force diagrams or vector addition.

name: Basic shapes
summary: Plain SVG shapes and text (rect, circle, line, path, text) for simple objects such as a ball, a block, a label or a ground line.
